gaps.description: Persistent capability/model/provider/pricing registry is not yet wired; NODE-22 catalog and prices are injectable runtime configuration.
Production concurrency-safe budget reservation and immutable actual cost ledger are not yet bound to BudgetPort/CostTelemetryPort.
Paid provider streaming is fail-closed until provider acceptance and usage can be checkpointed through a streaming-aware NODE-20 bridge.
Production Vault/KMS secret retrieval, rotation and provider credential lifecycle are not composed; EnvironmentSecretProvider is a reference binding.
Production async image/video provider poll/webhook scheduling is not composed; normalized status/cancel contract and deterministic mock lifecycle exist.
Durable metrics, tracing, health persistence, redacted raw-response evidence and alerts are not yet composed.
Hosted GitHub Actions cannot be treated as PASS while the account billing/spending-limit condition prevents runner allocation.

apps/api imports lumi-model-gateway at runtime, but the formal lumi-api -> lumi-model-gateway workspace dependency edge has not been regenerated into the reviewed uv.lock in this connector-only environment. Full-workspace frozen install includes both packages; standalone lumi-api package deployment is not yet claimed until uv lock is regenerated in a trusted checkout.
